subject: Re: AWS Private Offer — term length and co-sell credit routing (HealthGrid)
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@healthgrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthGrid Procurement <procurement@healthgrid.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Private Offer pricing + term options

Hi Marcus,

Were ready to move forward with Redwood but procurement has two open questions before we request an AWS private offer: pricing for a 12-month vs 36-month term, and how co-sell credits would be routed (HealthGrid prefers seller credit to be visible on the AWS invoice). Our CFO (David Lee) generally prefers 12-month terms but is open to a longer commitment if the unit pricing delta is compelling.

Can you provide a short matrix (12m vs 36m) showing: list price, proposed discount, co-sell credit %, and activation timeline? Also our procurement team needs SOC2 evidence for vendor onboarding. If you can send a stub package and the pricing workbook we can start internal approvals.

Do you have an internal approval path for discounts >15% and any finance SLAs we should know about?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — wed like to lock terms this week if possible.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Director, Strategic Sourcing
HealthGrid

Attachments: procurement_template.xlsx (referenced)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private Offer pricing + term options

Hi Samantha — thanks, and congrats on the decision to proceed.

Quick summary up front: we can support both 12- and 36-month private offers. Attached is a concise pricing matrix and SOC2 evidence summary (see attachments). Proposed starter options:
- 12-month: list price with 12% standard discount; Redwood co-sell credit 10% (applied as seller credit visible on AWS invoice).
- 36-month: list price with 25% committed-term discount; Redwood co-sell credit 12% and we can include a mid-term review for scale credits.

Notes on approvals: discounts up to 15% can be signed off by Sales Ops + Regional Lead. Anything >15% requires Finance (VP Finance) approval and legal for PO term language. Karthik, can you confirm whether a 25% commit is within the delegations?

Next steps I propose:
1) Ill attach RDW_HealthGrid_pricing_v2.xlsx (pricing + unit economics) and SOC2_evidence_overview.pdf.
2) If HealthGrid prefers 12m, well prepare the AWS private offer with the seller-credit routing and a standard activation SOW.
3) If you confirm the term, well route the deal through HubSpot (deal id: 23456) and kick Finance review.

We can also offer a one-time onboarding credit ($5k) for a twelve-month, higher-usage pilot if that helps get CFO signoff.

Marcus Lin
Head of Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RDW_HealthGrid_pricing_v2.xlsx, SOC2_evidence_overview.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private Offer pricing + term options

Marcus / team,

Quick internal: 25% on a 36m term is at the edge but approvable with Finance signoff. If were offering onboarding credit + 12% co-sell on 12m, that should fit within the standard discount band (<=15%) and can be approved by Sales Ops + Vanessa. Vanessa, can you confirm Sales Ops OK for the $5k onboarding credit on a 12m?

Operational items to surface to HealthGrid:
- Seller credit visibility: this is a configuration on the private offer and AWS shows seller credits on the invoice, but procurement must opt to accept that format.
- Activation SLO: we need a signed PO (AWS private offer acceptance) + a short SOW to schedule onboarding (typical 2-week lead).
- Evidence: SOC2 PDF attached is a summary; procurement may request the full pack via secure transfer or portal.

If HealthGrid wants faster approval, position the 12m + 10% co-sell + $5k onboarding credit to the CFO as "annual commitment with flexible upgrade" and route for Sales Ops signoff.

Karthik
Director, Seller Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@healthgrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: David Lee <david.lee@healthgrid.com>, HealthGrid Procurement <procurement@healthgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Private Offer pricing + term options

Marcus — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. David (CFO) reviewed and prefers to proceed with the 12-month option + onboarding credit. Hes comfortable signing provided the co-sell credit is visible on the AWS invoice and we get the SOC2 summary in full (procurement will accept via secure SFTP).

Please prepare the AWS private offer at the 12m terms (12% discount, 10% seller credit visible on invoice) and well circulate for PO signature. Also include a short SOW for onboarding (2-week window). Our procurement lead (ccd) will share the PO template if you prefer DocuSign or the AWS private offer flow; procurement prefers the AWS private offer route where possible.

Samantha Ortiz
Director, Strategic Sourcing
HealthGrid

Attachments referenced: procurement_po_template.docx (will send separately)
